source: Source: PriceSpy UK price histories, 13 big UK retailers, May 2025–Nov 2026

slides.p: We tracked daily prices for 33 popular products at 13 big UK retailers for 18 months.

slides.h2: Products at their lowest price of the year on Black Friday 2025
slides.p: Every Black Friday price was matched or beaten within six months. 22 were beaten outright.

slides.h2: But most were cheaper than usual
slides.p: Typical saving: 10.9% (£35) on the price they usually sold for.

slides.h2: Black Friday to Cyber Monday was the cheapest stretch in 18 months
slides.p: On average, prices were 14% below their usual level.

items: 30 of 33 had been at the same price or lower in the 6 months before
Echo Dot: the same £29.99 in October, November and December
5 of 33 rose 5%+ in October, then were “cut”
4 had no saving at all, including AirPods Pro 2 and the Switch OLED
